# Remotion project (generated by tools/new_project.mjs)

- `src/data/timeline.json` is written by `tools/timing/build_timeline.mjs`. Do not edit it by hand: change the storyboard and rebuild.
- `src/data/style.json` holds the style pack tokens (colours, fonts, safe zone).
- Add a component: create `src/components/MyThing.tsx`, add one line to `src/components/registry.ts`, then name it in the storyboard.
- Animate ONLY with `useCurrentFrame()`-based helpers (`interpolate`, `spring`, `src/engine/anim.ts`). No CSS transitions, no `setTimeout`, no `useFrame()` from react-three-fiber: they flicker when rendered.
- Preview: `npm run studio`. One frame: `npx remotion still src/index.ts Reel out/f.png --frame=90`. Render: `npx remotion render src/index.ts Reel out/video.mp4`.
